annotations.title: See what's working in a niche

description:
Use this when the user wants to know what is working for clips like theirs this week: "what is trending in my
niche", "what hooks work on TikTok". Returns this week's insights from top public clips (openings, lengths,
title styles, topics) with tips and examples. Premium: refused on the free plan. Built weekly; status
building means try again in a few minutes.
Not for: the user's own post numbers (weekly_report) or rising posts (whats_taking_off). Free and read only.

category.description: A niche such as Fortnite, Minecraft or IRL. Empty picks the one that matches the user's own videos.

platform.description: all, tiktok or youtube. Default all.
